watches.name: A-11 LMUV - FRESH GREEN
watches.description: With a dial cut from the hood of a WWII Willys MB, the A-11 LMUV Fresh Green was created to commemorate the 82nd Anniversary of D-Day on June 6th, 2026. The Willys MB was the U.S. Army's standard light utility vehicle throughout the Second World War, serving across every major theater of the conflict. On June 6th, 1944, these vehicles came ashore in Normandy alongside Allied forces, playing a vital role in reconnaissance, logistics, command, and transport operations. For this project, we recovered steel from the hood of an original Willys MB and transformed it into watch dials. Through a controlled blasting process, different layers of original paint are gradually revealed, exposing the history embedded in the metal itself. Because every section of the hood aged differently over decades of use, each dial offers its own unique combination of textures, colors, scratches, and patina. Available across five distinct dial variations, every A-11 LMUV represents a different stage in the life of the same historic vehicle. No artificial aging, no printed effect, and no two dials exactly alike. Built around our modern interpretation of the WWII A-11 field watch, the LMUV Fresh Green combines historic material with contemporary reliability through a sapphire crystal, automatic movement, and robust everyday-wear specifications. Created from a vehicle that helped carry Allied forces across Europe, the A-11 LMUV is not inspired by history, it is made from it.

watches.name: Bonklip Field Bracelet (For 40mm)
watches.description: Originally developed in the 1920s, the Bonklip Bracelet became popular thanks to the unique construction of its links. The hollow links meant that this steel bracelet was easily adjustable to your wrist in a similar fashion as a leather or canvas strap would have been. The Bonklip really rose to popularity in the 40s thanks to its unprecedented affordability as a stainless steel bracelet sold mainly by B.H. Britton and Sons. The Bonklip's career rose to new heights in the 50s & 60s when the British Ministry of Defense issued them to RAF aircrews. Other useful benefits stemming from the Bonklip's links was the increased breathability and reduced weight of the bracelet compared to a "full" stainless steel bracelet making them popular for field watches. During our A-11 Type 44 research, we found that Bonklip Bracelets were used on A-11s during WW2 due to their unique attributes combined with the ruggedness provided by steel. Originally produced only for our A-11 Type 44 collection, we've now made the bracelet available for purchase on itself. Featuring Capsa spring-bars built into the bracelet, its easy to switch around on your watches without having to bother with standard spring bars.

watches.name: DD-45 "Desert Field"
watches.description: The DD-45 "Desert Field" is our modern interpretation of what a British military field watch would look like if it were issued today, built with the same utilitarian spirit, but engineered for contemporary reliability. Designed as a homage to the original Dirty Dozen designed for the British War Office to equip the British Army with a standardized high-performance field watch, the DD-45 surpasses the originals spec wise bringing it to the 21st century. Originally meant to be "Waterproof" we've modernized the initial design requirements. The DD-45 comes with 10ATM water resistance & a screw-down crown - helping to keep things safe in wet conditions. The double domed sapphire crystal provides best in-class scratch resistance further improving the longevity of your DD-45. While the originals were mechanical, this modern execution features a high-precision Quartz movement that is chosen for its superior accuracy, reliability, and low maintenance. Built for everyday field use, it delivers consistent performance without the need for winding, making it a practical tool for modern life.

watches.name: DD-45 "Field Olive"
watches.description: The DD-45 "Field Olive" is our modern interpretation of what a British military field watch would look like if it were issued today. Built with the same spirit we've re-engineered it for contemporary American reliability. Designed as a homage to the original Dirty Dozen designed for the British War Office to equip the British Army with a standardized high-performance field watch, the DD-45 surpasses the originals spec wise bringing it to the 21st century. Originally meant to be "Waterproof" we've modernized the initial design requirements. The Praesidus DD-45 preserves that utilitarian layout while upgrading it for modern usage. A push/pull crown and 10 ATM water resistance improve protection in wet environments, with a flat crystal glass. While the originals were mechanical, this modern execution features a high-precision Ameriquartz movement that is chosen for its superior accuracy, reliability, and low maintenance. Built for everyday field use, it delivers consistent performance without the need for winding, making it a practical tool for modern life.

watches.name: 250th Anniversary Bronze - Black Leather
watches.description: America 250 Special Edition Introducing the Praesidus 250th Anniversary Bronze - Black Leather, a commemorative field watch created to honor the 250th anniversary of the United States . Inspired by the military-issued A-11 that accompanied American servicemen through World War II, this special edition celebrates not only the nation's founding, but the generations who have defended its ideals ever since. Housed in a solid CuSn8 bronze case , each watch develops its own unique patina over time, making every piece a personal record of its owner's journey. Just as history leaves its mark on a nation, time leaves its mark on bronze. Built as both a tribute and a tool watch, the 250th Anniversary Bronze Edition combines historically inspired design with modern reliability: crafted for collectors, veterans, history enthusiasts, and anyone proud of America's enduring legacy.

watches.name: A-11 Utah Beach - Steel Tide
watches.description: Ultra-Limited Edition Featuring real sand from Utah Beach and the most elaborate hand-painted execution of the collection, the Utah Beach Steel Tide was created for collectors seeking the pinnacle of the Utah Beach 82nd Anniversary series. Its dial combines authentic beach sand with individually painted scenes depicting the immense armada that crossed the English Channel and delivered Allied forces to the shores of Normandy. Rich metallic tones and layered textures create a sense of depth rarely seen on a watch dial, making every piece a unique work of historical art. As with all watches in the collection, no two dials are identical. Each one is painted individually, preserving the human element behind the craftsmanship and ensuring every watch tells its own story. Produced in exceptionally small numbers, Steel Tide represents the most exclusive expression of the Utah Beach concept to date. Created to honor the men, ships, and sacrifice that made D-Day possible, the Utah Beach Steel Tide transforms history into a permanent part of the watch itself.

Inspired by the uncertainty, danger, and determination that defined the early hours of June 6th, 1944, Dark Storm combines authentic Utah Beach sand with a darker, more detailed artistic composition. The storm-grey tones evoke the skies, smoke, and battlefield conditions faced by Allied forces as they pushed inland from the beaches of Normandy. Each dial is individually painted by hand, ensuring that no two examples are exactly alike. The result is a miniature historical canvas that captures both the chaos and courage of D-Day. Produced in extremely limited quantities, the Dark Storm is intended for collectors seeking a more exclusive and highly detailed interpretation of the Normandy landings. Built to preserve both memory and material history, it stands as a tribute to those who faced the storm and changed the course of the war.

watches.name: A-11 Utah Beach - Surf Blue
watches.description: Limited to 150 Pieces Featuring real sand from Utah Beach and a hand-painted D-Day scene, the Utah Beach Surf Blue was created to commemorate the 82nd Anniversary of the Normandy landings on June 6th, 2026. The original Utah Beach collection incorporated authentic sand collected from the beach itself. For this anniversary edition, we wanted to take the concept further by bringing the story to life directly on the dial. Each Surf Blue dial features a hand-painted depiction of the Normandy landings set against a vibrant blue backdrop inspired by the waters that carried Allied forces toward the French coast on D-Day. Combined with real Utah Beach sand, every watch becomes a unique interpretation of one of history's most consequential military operations. Limited to 150 pieces, the Surf Blue serves as the foundation of the Utah Beach 82nd collection, pairing artistic craftsmanship with genuine historical material. Created as a tribute to the men who landed on Utah Beach on June 6th, 1944, the Utah Beach Surf Blue transforms a defining moment of history into something that can be worn and remembered every day.

watches.name: A-11 Tactical Navy
watches.description: The A-11 Tactical Navy is built from the original U.S. Military Specification for Service Watches issued in 1942 - an all-purpose instrument designed for battlefield reliability and instant readability. This execution holds that brief. A stripped, high-contrast dial delivers immediate legibility in any condition. Indexes and hands are fully lumed to maintain visibility in low light without compromise. A double-domed sapphire crystal sits above the dial, shaped to replicate the boxed acrylic crystals used on original A-11s. The profile stays true to the period, while sapphire brings modern scratch resistance and long-term clarity. Inside, the watch moves to a modern Miyota 8025 automatic - adding a date function while preserving mechanical dependability for daily wear. Each piece is assembled in the United States and fitted on a tan leather strap, staying aligned with the functional roots of the original A-11.

Their design established the blueprint for the modern military field watch: simple, highly legible, and built for reliability under pressure. The Praesidus DD-45 preserves that utilitarian layout while upgrading it for modern durability. A screw-down crown and 10 ATM water resistance improve protection in wet environments, while a double-domed sapphire-coated crystal shields the dial from scratches and everyday wear. Inside, the watch is powered by a high-precision American-built quartz movement . Chosen for its accuracy, reliability, and minimal maintenance requirements, it delivers consistent timekeeping without the need for winding - making it a practical tool for daily use. Each DD-45 is assembled in the United States , combining one of the most recognizable military field watch designs ever produced with modern materials and dependable performance.

No two dials will be exactly the same, each one develops its own character over time. The Neptune-44 is not a reproduction. It’s a living relic, forged in salt and memory, and a tribute to the enduring legacy of those who landed before us. Each Neptune-44 sold will have a percentage of its sale given back the UTAH BEACH Landing Museum in Normandy. The donation will be used to thanks them for their support in the project.

This is a transformation by exposure, not surface treatment. Each scratch tells the story of waves crashing over steel, a natural patina earned in the very waters of D-Day. The dial continues this rugged tribute with a black aged finish, specially developed for this release. Indexes are patina’d and subdued, echoing the wear and weathering of real field instruments. No two dials will be exactly the same, each one develops its own character over time. The Neptune-44 is not a reproduction. It’s a living relic, forged in salt and memory, and a tribute to the enduring legacy of those who landed before us. Each Neptune-44 sold will have a percentage of its sale given back the UTAH BEACH Landing Museum in Normandy. The donation will be used to thanks them for their support in the project.

watches.name: A-11 PSYWAR Limited Edition
watches.description: Designed in collaboration with Psywarwristcheck, we've used our A-11 Tom Rice as a base for this limited edition. Each piece will feature its own serial number on the caseback - these will be attributed by order number (the earlier the order, the lower the number). All indexes & hands will be coated in Super Luminova for peak night-time performance & readability. As a bit of backstory to the design, the original A-11 specification was developed by the US Military in 1942 with the objective of equipping soldiers with a rugged & legible field watch. The result was the A-11 specification; meant to bring the US military to a "modern" standard for the time. These watches saw combat throughout WW2 on the wrists of American & allied soldier before being replaced by the A-17 spec during the Korean War. Currently, we have shipped out all Batch 1 orders. watches.name: Americana Pipedream X Praesidus
watches.description: Designed in collaboration with Americana Pipedream Apparel, this 100-piece limited edition pays tribute to the different types of dress patterns used during the Vietnam War. Inspired by three iconic patterns from the field — Tiger Stripe, OG-107, and ERDL Camo — we built this release from the ground up with purpose and authenticity in mind. To that effect, Americana Pipedream sent us actual pieces they sourced of ERDL & Tiger Stripe so we could get our patterns absolutely perfect. Two custom camo straps were developed exclusively for this drop: a leather Tiger Stripe strap and a rugged ERDL camo canvas strap — each capturing a distinct chapter of the conflict’s gear history. A nod to the classic OG-107 uniform green can be found on the date window — a subtle detail honoring the standard issue of U.S. troops deployed in Vietnam. At its core, the Rec Spec is a tribute to the legendary MACV-SOG Watch — a non-issued timepiece often sourced from local Asian markets by elite MACV-SOG units. These covert operators required gear that flew under the radar — untraceable and unregulated — for missions deep in Laos and Cambodia.

watches.name: A-11 RCPT USA
watches.description: Built in collaboration with RCPT USA (Round Canopy Parachute Team), this limited edition marks the 80th Anniversary of D-Day. Just 50 pieces made. The design features the unmistakable D-Day Invasion Stripes — three white, two black — the same bold markings painted across the wings and fuselage of Allied aircraft on June 6th, 1944. Their purpose was clear: prevent friendly fire in the chaos of the invasion. We engraved the RCPT USA emblem on the caseback and placed it on the dial — a tribute to their mission and the legacy they carry forward. Based on our US-Mil Spec A-11 Service Watch design, the build includes a domed K1 mineral glass and a reliable NH35 automatic movement — no-nonsense specs for a watch rooted in history. This collab directly supports RCPT USA’s mission: to honor WWII Allied paratroopers by bringing their spirit to life through modern-day round canopy jumps, preserving their stories, and building camaraderie among those who jump in their footsteps.

watches.name: Rec Spec 553
watches.description: The Rec Spec 553 is a spin-off of the original MACV-SOG watches of the 60s. Featuring a brand new Khaki Brown coloration inspired by the traditional military color schemes, this dial brings a bit of freshness to the collection while keeping close to the original field watch aesthetic. The 38mm case size combined with the 4-Hour integrated crown placement provides excellent wearability in all conditions - whether in or off the field. The integrated crown design also serves to protect it from getting pulled out inadvertently while reducing the overall wrist presence. Complete with a custom collaboration caseback engraved with the unit's emblem. Powered by a workhorse NH36 TMI movement with 39-hours of power reserve, hacking & a day-date complication just like the original 1960s versions.

watches.name: Rec Spec - Night Vision - DNC Green
watches.description: The Rec Spec Night Vision – DNC Green reimagines the rarely-seen Desert Night Camouflage through a bold new lens, featuring a deep, grid-patterned military green that merges tactical design with historical authenticity. Inspired by gear deployed during U.S. night operations, this dial pays tribute to those who worked in silence and shadow. The 38mm sandblasted stainless steel case offers excellent wearability with a low-profile silhouette suited for both field operations and everyday use. Its grid-textured dial comes paired with Block Super-LumiNova indices and hands, providing exceptional visibility in darkness without compromising the watch's stealth-focused mission. Inside beats the reliable NH36 automatic movement, featuring a hacking function and 41-hour power reserve – delivering the same dependable performance as vintage military timepieces without unnecessary complications. With 50M water resistance and a black vulcanized rubber strap, this watch stands ready for deployment in any environment.

watches.name: Rec Spec - Night Vision - DNC Brown
watches.description: The Rec Spec Night Vision - DNC Brown distinguishes itself with its earth-toned tribute to military history, featuring a textured brown grid pattern dial that directly references the forgotten Desert Night Camouflage uniforms of the Gulf War era. Unlike its stealthier siblings, this model embraces visual depth through its distinctive chocolate-hued camouflage pattern that creates a subtle three-dimensional effect across the dial face. The 38mm sandblasted case serves as the perfect framework for this unique colorway, where the warm brown tones create a vintage-inspired aesthetic that balances tactical heritage with everyday wearability. Each angle reveals different light interactions with the textured grid pattern, making this model particularly dynamic throughout changing light conditions. Powered by the reliable NH36 automatic movement, this historically-inspired timepiece maintains precision with its 41-hour power reserve and military-spec hacking function. The 50M water resistance ensures this desert-inspired companion remains ready for any environment. Created for history enthusiasts and those drawn to the road less traveled, the DNC Brown edition represents an obscure chapter of military design history translated into a functional everyday tool. For collectors seeking something beyond standard-issue black, this uniquely warm tactical timepiece stands as a conversation starter with genuine historical significance.

watches.name: Rec Spec - Night Vision - Midnight Black
watches.description: The Rec Spec Night Vision – Midnight Black stands apart with its tactical stealth approach, featuring a distinctive matte black dial that disappears into the shadows while remaining instantly readable when needed. Unlike its DNC-patterned siblings, this model embraces total darkness with its phantom-like presence and zero-reflection philosophy. The 38mm sandblasted stainless steel case provides the perfect canvas for this nighttime specialist, where the absence of pattern becomes its defining characteristic. With a clean, symmetrical no-date layout, the Midnight Black achieves a level of utilitarian perfection rarely seen in modern watchmaking. Inside beats the trustworthy NH36 automatic movement with its 41-hour power reserve and hacking capability, allowing for precise synchronization during time-sensitive operations. The 50M water resistance ensures this shadow warrior remains operational in all environments. Built for those who move unseen and prefer to leave no trace, the Midnight Black edition offers a different kind of statement - one of calculated restraint and purposeful design. For the operator who understands that sometimes, nothing is more tactical than nothing at all.

watches.name: PAC-76 Black Leather
watches.description: The PAC-76 is a revival of the now by-gone era of military analog chronographs. Its distinct over-sized 12 and 6 indexes are both a legibility choice as well as a 70s aesthetic choice ; the last decade of mechanical chronograph dominance. Our design pays homage to the bi-compax chronographs used mainly by the USAF & RAF. Back then, pilots would use the chrono function as a calculation tool on the fly for speed, fuel consumption and navigation. Featuring increased the legibility through the use of varying textures, the PAC-76 is a modernized take on the original layout. Both debossed sub-dials have gotten a Vinyl texture while the main dial uses a popcorn texture reducing the risk of confusion when glancing at the watch. With embossed indexes as well, there’s plenty of volume to increase legibility. The Black Leather Strap variation of the PAC-76 is the most classic version; matching the main dial color of the watch-head for a functional yet elegant combo.

watches.description: When we got access to our Marston Mat straight from the fields of Normandy in June 2021, we knew that we were onto something special. One year later, we've successfully managed to preserve this historical piece of D-Day by converting it into watch dials that fit the A-11 Spec designs from the same period. Protected by a stainless steel case & a double domed sapphire crystal, your piece of the historical metal has been given a new lease on life. watches.name: A-11 Combat
watches.description: The A-11 Combat is our attempt at taking our homage to this legendary tool watch a step further by using the original WW2 32mm case size. By today’s standards, 32mm is rarely seen for a men’s watch however, back in the 40s it was anything but. With numerous A-11s produced during the war, these were meant to equip Allied Soldiers during combat. Its small size was intentional, allowing for it to be unobtrusive of wrist movement during combat and less resource intensive to produce. Largely regarded as a massive success, it performed admirably in all conditions as a simple yet effective military tool watch. This decision to launch the A-11 Combat comes after we bought up a vintage Elgin A-11 on E-bay. We de-assembled it, studied each and every component and decided that we had to take a leap and re-launch an authentically sized A-11 homage. Despite going with the authentic 1942 case size, we’ve brought on a couple of modernizations to our A-11 Combat. Most notably, we use a Stainless Steel case (instead of the original brass or silver cases) and have upgraded the movement to an ultra precise Swiss Ronda Movement. We also took the liberty to use Super Luminova on our dials to ensure low-light visibility in all circumstances. All our A-11s are assembled directly in the United States and, the A-11 Combat is no exception.

watches.name: A-11 Type 44 Patina
watches.description: Make no mistake, the A-11 Type 44 is not an attempt by us to replace the original A-11s that can still be easily found on the market. With the history they bear, it'd be unfair to even attempt it. The Type 44, is rather a watch that guarantees modern day quality & timekeeping while being an ultra-authentic homage to the incredible story of these originals. With its stainless steel case & 10 ATM water-resistant construction, the Type 44 is definitely more rugged than the originals. Its Swiss-made manual-wind movement will also guarantee you a level of precision & functionality that a 80y/o original A-11 cannot. So if you're looking for an A-11 that you can actually wear without risk & that truly incarnates the incredible American ingenuity & bravery of the men behind the originals, the A-11 Type 44 is for you. Seeped in American history, you can choose from the ultra authentic 32mm to the more modern 38mm. Featuring a 1940s style Bonklip Bracelet, the Type 44 truly is a 1940s revival ready for the 21st Century. American Assembled as always.

watches.name: Camo X The Rifle
watches.description: The A-11 Camo X The Rifle is a limited edition in collaboration with Andrew Biggio - author & owner of The Rifle. This A-11 is meant to honor the Heroes of the Pacific - too often forgotten. "The Rifle" originally refers to an M1 Garand Service Rifle with which Andrew would visit & talk with WW2 veterans. Being the standard issue rifle of the time, each veteran has had an experience with it. Andrew's M1 has now become iconic as it is covered in signatures from all of the WW2 veterans that he has met. The A-11 Camo take inspiration from the M1 Garand through its steel case that features a distinct "gun" plating that tries to match the original plating of the M1's Barrel. For the dial, we directly inspired ourselves from the M1942 "Frog Skin" camouflage that the US Marines Corps used during the Pacific Campaign in South-East Asia. Featuring Swiss Super-Luminova, the watch will perform extremely well in low-light conditions with easy & durable legibility. Each A-11 Camo is equipped with a P024 Swiss Automatic movement & will come either with a "The Rifle" book or, a direct donation to support Andrew Biggio & his incredible work with the Vets.

We offer both 38 & 42mm case sizes for easy readibility and comfort on the wrist. Finally, as always our A-11s are US assembled and, equipped with a green canvas strap.
